rationale.conceptual: The paper proposes its own custom method combining iterative SCF under external charges, pair energy correction for double-counted polarization, and numerical lattice optimization. Implementing it correctly requires genuine understanding of the method and non-trivial translation of the equations into code, even though the underlying theories (HF, MP2) are standard.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves ~4-6 stages (crystal setup, iterative polarization, optimization, MP2 recalculation, output) with dependencies. It requires interfacing with an external ab initio package and managing convergence, but the overall workflow is linear and not excessively long.
